write_detailed_allele_table.description: Enable writing of the detailed allele table.

quantification_window_size.description: Defines the size in bp of the quantification window extending from the quantification window center. Mutations within this distance are used to classify reads as modified or unmodified. A value of 0 disables the window so indels in the entire amplicon are considered.

quantification_window_center.description: Defines the center of the quantification window relative to the 3' end of the sgRNA. The default -3 is suitable for Cas9.

quantification_window_coordinates.description: Specifies bp coordinates in the amplicon that form the quantification window. Coordinates are 0-based and can be specified as ranges such as 5-10. Multiple ranges can be separated with underscores. A value of 0 disables the quantification-window filter.

exclude_bp_from_left.description: Exclude this number of bp from the left side of the amplicon when quantifying indels.

exclude_bp_from_right.description: Exclude this number of bp from the right side of the amplicon when quantifying indels.

ignore_substitutions.description: Ignore substitution events for quantification and visualization.

ignore_insertions.description: Ignore insertion events for quantification and visualization.

ignore_deletions.description: Ignore deletion events for quantification and visualization.

discard_indel_reads.description: Discard reads containing indels in the quantification window from the analysis.

use_legacy_insertion_quantification.description: Use the legacy insertion quantification method.
